test_title: PYST 14: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 10 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

The project was delayed/because of unforeseen issues;/consequency, we had/to adjust our timeline./
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. consequency, we had .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"consequency"** is incorrect in the given sentence. The correct word should be **"consequently."**
 
• **"Consequently"** is an adverb used to mean "as a result" or "therefore," and fits the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• The rest of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.

Correct sentence: *The project was delayed because of unforeseen issues; consequently, we had to adjust our timeline.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Adverbs:**
 
 
• Adverbs like **"consequently," "therefore," and "thus"** are used to show cause-and-effect relationships.
 
• Correct placement of adverbs ensures clarity and coherence in sentences.
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Misspelling or incorrect usage of words can change the meaning or make the sentence grammatically incorrect.
 
• Always cross-check the spelling and meaning of words in formal writing.
